exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix impact-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card apply localization-plan.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/applied.txt

exec card --actor language-owner --json checkpoint deny --reason 'Terminology conflicts with policy.' impact-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/denied.json
exec card --json ready
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/unaffected.jsonl
